tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen ground behind every list and scroll view. Cards sit on it with no border and no shadow — the white-on-grey step is the separation.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, the floating icon button, photo score chips. Dark uses stone-900 (iOS grouped style) so a borderless card still reads against `bg` (1.23:1 in dark; the old stone-950 was 1.07:1).

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Filled inputs, the in-sheet close button, subtle ScoreBadge, placeholders.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet ground; its cards are `panel`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px row dividers inside a card list. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Timeline rail and other purely decorative rules. Deliberately below 3:1 — a line that carries meaning (a control's border) uses `line-control`.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of an outlined control: outline buttons, outlined inputs, the `oneAndDone` pill. At least 3:1 on `panel`, `bg`, `sunken` and `sheet` in both themes, which a control border must meet.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The unfilled part of a Bar, and a Toggle's off track. Deliberately low against the surface: a meter is read by where its fill ends, and fill-against-track is 5.2:1 light / 3.6:1 dark, which is what 1.4.11 asks of the part that carries the meaning. Raising the track would lower that.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind a sheet.

tokens.name: grabber
tokens.usage: The sheet's drag handle. Aliases `line-control`: it is an affordance, not decoration, so it clears 3:1 on `sheet` (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, names, scores' verdict words, input text: 16.0:1 on `bg` light, 17.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy and summaries under a title: 9.6:1 on `bg` light, 11.0:1 on `panel` dark.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Meta lines, section labels, captions, 'as usual', placeholders: 5.6:1 on `bg`, 6.3:1 on `panel`, 5.2:1 on `sunken` light; 7.6:1 on `panel` dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid outline, 2px offset.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary role fill: solid primary buttons and badges, progress fill, current timeline dot, chevrons. `on-primary` on it is 6.4:1 light; 2.98:1 dark (kept from the app's dark pine).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Primary role soft ground (soft buttons and badges, avatar fallback). Carries `primary-text`.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Primary role text: soft/outline/ghost primary buttons and badges, counts, positive deltas, score numerals. 6.4:1 on `panel`, 5.5:1 on `primary-soft` light; 9.0:1 on `panel` dark.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `primary` fill. Dark `primary` is the light pine-400 fill, so its ink is pine-900 (5.16:1); white would be 2.98:1.

tokens.name: primary-muted
tokens.usage: Past timeline dots (the current one is `primary`). A mark, not text.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary role fill: solid secondary buttons and badges — ink on light, light on dark.

tokens.name: secondary-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary role soft ground: soft secondary buttons (Reset Filters, sheet close) and badges.

tokens.name: secondary-text
tokens.usage: Secondary role text: soft/outline/ghost secondary. 8.8:1 on `secondary-soft` light, 8.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `secondary` fill: 17.8:1 light, 14.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive role fill: solid destructive buttons, irreversible actions only. iOS system red darkened 15% (same hue) so white text reaches 4.7:1 light and 4.6:1 dark; the undarkened #ff3b30 gave 3.6:1.

tokens.name: destructive-soft
tokens.usage: Destructive role soft ground.

tokens.name: destructive-text
tokens.usage: Red text on a pale ground: inline errors, destructive labels. Dark value clears 4.5:1 on `sunken` (the field ground), not just on `panel`.

tokens.name: on-destructive
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `destructive` fill. White both themes: 4.73:1 light, 4.55:1 dark.

tokens.name: pro
tokens.usage: Pro role fill: solid Pro buttons ("Unlock with Pro"). `on-pro` on it 15.8:1 / 10.4:1.

tokens.name: pro-soft
tokens.usage: Pro role soft ground (Pro badges, gated-card grounds). Violet means Pro and nothing else.

tokens.name: pro-text
tokens.usage: Pro label text. Dark value clears 4.5:1 on `sunken`.

tokens.name: on-pro
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `pro` fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning role fill (solid warning badges). `on-warning` on it 6.5:1 / 6.8:1.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning role soft ground: a negative change badge ('−2').

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning role text: negative change ('−2', '−4 usual'). 5.7:1 on `warning-soft`, 6.5:1 on `panel` light; 6.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `warning` fill.

tokens.name: reaction-inedible-text

groups.name: Serif
